numerator_hw_meaning: SQ_INSTS_VALU_* counters * 64 work-items: total VALU floating-point operations issued (per-simd, emulated)
denominator_hw_meaning: End_Timestamp - Start_Timestamp: kernel wall-clock time in ns
correct_aggregate_definition: Total FLOPs across all dispatches / total wall-clock time = actual sustained throughput

numerator_hw_meaning: SQ_INSTS_VALU_INT32 + SQ_INSTS_VALU_INT64: number of VALU integer instructions issued (per-simd, emulated) * 64 work-items
correct_aggregate_definition: Total IOPs / total time

numerator_hw_meaning: SQ_INSTS_VALU_MFMA_MOPS_F8: number of F8 MFMA instructions * 512 ops/instr (per-simd, emulated)
correct_aggregate_definition: Total F8 MFMA ops / total time

numerator_hw_meaning: MFMA BF16 instruction count * 512
correct_aggregate_definition: Total BF16 MFMA ops / total time

numerator_hw_meaning: MFMA F16 instruction count * 512
correct_aggregate_definition: Total F16 MFMA ops / total time

numerator_hw_meaning: MFMA F32 instruction count * 512
correct_aggregate_definition: Total F32 MFMA ops / total time

numerator_hw_meaning: MFMA F64 instruction count * 512
correct_aggregate_definition: Total F64 MFMA ops / total time

numerator_hw_meaning: MFMA F6/F4 instruction count * 512
correct_aggregate_definition: Total F6F4 MFMA ops / total time

numerator_hw_meaning: MFMA INT8 instruction count * 512
correct_aggregate_definition: Total INT8 MFMA ops / total time

numerator_hw_meaning: SQ_ACTIVE_INST_SCA: quad-cycles SQ instruction arbiter working on SALU/SMEM instruction (per-simd, emulated)
denominator_hw_meaning: $GRBM_GUI_ACTIVE_PER_XCD: GUI active cycles (per XCD) * $cu_per_gpu: number of CUs = total CU-cycles available
correct_aggregate_definition: What fraction of total CU-cycles was SALU busy? Must weight by GPU active cycles across dispatches.

numerator_hw_meaning: SQ_ACTIVE_INST_VALU: quad-cycles SQ instruction arbiter working on VALU instruction (per-simd, emulated)
correct_aggregate_definition: What fraction of total CU-cycles was VALU busy? Weighted by active cycles.

numerator_hw_meaning: SQ_VALU_MFMA_BUSY_CYCLES: cycles MFMA unit was busy (per-simd)
denominator_hw_meaning: Total MFMA pipe-cycles (4 pipes per CU * CU-cycles)
correct_aggregate_definition: What fraction of MFMA pipe-cycles was MFMA busy? Weighted by active cycles.

numerator_hw_meaning: SQ_ACTIVE_INST_FLAT + SQ_ACTIVE_INST_VMEM: quad-cycles arbiter working on VMEM/FLAT instructions (per-simd, emulated)
correct_aggregate_definition: What fraction of CU-cycles was VMEM busy? Weighted by active cycles.

numerator_hw_meaning: SQ_ACTIVE_INST_MISC: quad-cycles arbiter working on branch/sendmsg instructions (per-simd, emulated)
correct_aggregate_definition: What fraction of CU-cycles was branch unit busy? Weighted by active cycles.

current_formula: AVG((SQ_THREAD_CYCLES_VALU / SQ_ACTIVE_INST_VALU) if SQ_ACTIVE_INST_VALU != 0 else None)
numerator_hw_meaning: SQ_THREAD_CYCLES_VALU: quad-cycles VALU in use * active thread count (per-simd)
denominator_hw_meaning: SQ_ACTIVE_INST_VALU: quad-cycles arbiter working on VALU (per-simd, emulated)
correct_aggregate_definition: Average active work-items per VALU instruction. Weighted by VALU instruction count.

numerator_hw_meaning: SQ_INSTS: number of instructions issued (per-simd, emulated)
denominator_hw_meaning: SQ_BUSY_CU_CYCLES: quad-cycles each CU is busy (nondeterministic, per-simd)
correct_aggregate_definition: Overall instructions per busy CU cycle. Weighted by busy cycle count.

numerator_hw_meaning: SQ_ACCUM_PREV_HIRES: level counter — accumulates value of previous counter (SQ_LEVEL_WAVES = resident wavefront count) once per cycle
correct_aggregate_definition: Time-averaged resident wavefronts. Weighted by active cycles.

numerator_hw_meaning: SQ_LDS_IDX_ACTIVE - SQ_LDS_BANK_CONFLICT: uncontended LDS access cycles * 4 bytes * banks_per_cu = theoretical bytes transferred
correct_aggregate_definition: Total theoretical LDS bytes / total time.

numerator_hw_meaning: SQ_LDS_BANK_CONFLICT: cycles LDS stalled due to bank conflicts (per-simd)
denominator_hw_meaning: SQ_LDS_IDX_ACTIVE - SQ_LDS_BANK_CONFLICT: uncontended LDS access cycles
correct_aggregate_definition: Overall ratio of conflict cycles to uncontended cycles. Weighted by LDS access volume.

numerator_hw_meaning: TCP_TOTAL_CACHE_ACCESSES_sum - MISS_REQS (sum over CUs): total cache line lookups that hit in vL1D
denominator_hw_meaning: TCP_TOTAL_CACHE_ACCESSES_sum: total cache line lookups in vL1D (sum over all CUs)
correct_aggregate_definition: Overall hit rate across all accesses. Weighted by access count.

numerator_hw_meaning: TCP_TOTAL_CACHE_ACCESSES_sum * 128: total bytes looked up in vL1D (accesses * 128B cache line, sum over CUs)
correct_aggregate_definition: Total vL1D bytes / total time.

current_formula: AVG((100 * TCC_HIT_sum) / (TCC_HIT_sum + TCC_MISS_sum) if != 0 else None)
numerator_hw_meaning: TCC_HIT_sum: number of L2 cache hits (sum over all L2 channels)
denominator_hw_meaning: TCC_HIT_sum + TCC_MISS_sum: total L2 cache lookups (sum over channels)
correct_aggregate_definition: Overall L2 hit rate. Weighted by total request count.

numerator_hw_meaning: TCC_REQ_sum: number of L2 requests of all types at tag block (sum over channels) * 128B
correct_aggregate_definition: Total L2 bytes / total time.

numerator_hw_meaning: TCC_EA0_RDREQ_*B_sum: number of EA read requests by size (sum over channels), weighted by request size
correct_aggregate_definition: Total fabric read bytes / total time.

numerator_hw_meaning: TCC_EA0_WRREQ*_sum: number of EA write requests by size (sum over channels), weighted by request size
correct_aggregate_definition: Total fabric write bytes / total time.

numerator_hw_meaning: TCC_EA0_RDREQ_LEVEL_sum: accumulated in-flight EA read requests (sum over channels) — HW spec says: for measuring average EA read latency
denominator_hw_meaning: TCC_EA0_RDREQ_sum: total EA read requests (sum over channels)
correct_aggregate_definition: Average cycles per read request. HW designed for SUM(LEVEL)/SUM(REQ). Weighted by request count.

numerator_hw_meaning: TCC_EA0_WRREQ_LEVEL_sum: accumulated in-flight EA write requests (sum over channels)
correct_aggregate_definition: Average cycles per write request. Weighted by request count.

current_formula: AVG((100 * SQC_DCACHE_HITS / (SQC_DCACHE_HITS + SQC_DCACHE_MISSES)) if != 0 else None)
numerator_hw_meaning: SQC_DCACHE_HITS: sL1D cache hits
correct_aggregate_definition: Overall sL1D hit rate. Weighted by request count.

numerator_hw_meaning: SQC_DCACHE_REQ: total sL1D requests * 64B line size
correct_aggregate_definition: Total sL1D bytes / total time.

numerator_hw_meaning: SQC_ICACHE_HITS: L1I cache hits
correct_aggregate_definition: Overall L1I hit rate. Weighted by request count.

numerator_hw_meaning: SQC_ICACHE_REQ: total L1I requests * 64B
correct_aggregate_definition: Total L1I bytes / total time.

numerator_hw_meaning: SQ_ACCUM_PREV_HIRES: level counter accumulating previous counter (SQ_IFETCH_LEVEL = in-flight instruction fetches)
denominator_hw_meaning: SQ_IFETCH: number of instruction fetch requests issued
correct_aggregate_definition: Average cycles per instruction fetch. Weighted by fetch count.

numerator_hw_meaning: SQ_BUSY_CU_CYCLES: quad-cycles each CU is busy (nondeterministic, per-simd)
denominator_hw_meaning: Total CU-cycles available (active cycles * CU count)
correct_aggregate_definition: What fraction of CU-cycles had any work? Weighted by active cycles.

numerator_hw_meaning: TCC_BUSY_sum: number of cycles L2 has a request pending (sum over channels, not windowable)
correct_aggregate_definition: What fraction of L2 channel-cycles were busy? Weighted by active cycles.

numerator_hw_meaning: TCC_HIT_sum: number of L2 cache hits (sum over channels)
correct_aggregate_definition: Overall L2 hit rate. Weighted by request count.

current_formula: AVG((100 * TCC_EA0_RDREQ_DRAM_sum / TCC_EA0_RDREQ_sum) if != 0 else None)
numerator_hw_meaning: TCC_EA0_RDREQ_DRAM_sum: EA read requests to local HBM (sum over channels)
denominator_hw_meaning: TCC_EA0_RDREQ_sum: total EA read requests (sum over channels)
correct_aggregate_definition: What fraction of fabric reads went to HBM? Weighted by request count.

numerator_hw_meaning: TCC_EA0_RDREQ_LEVEL_sum: accumulated in-flight EA reads — HW: "for measuring average EA read latency"
correct_aggregate_definition: Average cycles per request. HW designed as ratio of accumulated level / request count.

numerator_hw_meaning: TCC_EA0_WRREQ_LEVEL_sum: accumulated in-flight EA writes
correct_aggregate_definition: Average cycles per write request.

numerator_hw_meaning: TCC_EA0_ATOMIC_LEVEL_sum: accumulated in-flight EA atomics
correct_aggregate_definition: Average cycles per atomic request.

current_formula: AVG((100 * stall_cycles / TCC_BUSY_sum) if != 0 else None)
numerator_hw_meaning: TCC_EA0_RDREQ_*_CREDIT_STALL_sum: cycles read request runs out of IO/GMI/DRAM credits (sum over channels)
denominator_hw_meaning: TCC_BUSY_sum: L2 busy cycles (sum over channels, not windowable)
correct_aggregate_definition: What fraction of L2 busy cycles stalled on reads? Weighted by busy cycles.

numerator_hw_meaning: TCC_REQ_sum: number of requests of all types at tag block (sum over channels)
correct_aggregate_definition: Normalized request count — depends on $denom semantics.

current_formula: AVG((100 * TCC_HIT_sum / (TCC_HIT_sum + TCC_MISS_sum)) if != 0 else None)
numerator_hw_meaning: TCC_HIT_sum: L2 cache hits
correct_aggregate_definition: Overall L2 hit rate. Weighted by request count.

numerator_hw_meaning: TCC_REQ_sum * 128: L2 bytes
correct_aggregate_definition: Total L2 bytes / total time.

current_formula: AVG((100 * TCC_EA0_RDREQ_IO_CREDIT_STALL_sum / TCC_BUSY_sum) if != 0 else None)
numerator_hw_meaning: TCC_EA0_RDREQ_IO_CREDIT_STALL_sum: cycles EA read runs out of IO credits (sum over channels)
correct_aggregate_definition: Fraction of L2 busy cycles stalled on PCIe reads. Weighted by busy cycles.

numerator_hw_meaning: TCP_TOTAL_CACHE_ACCESSES_sum - miss_reqs: vL1D cache hits (sum over CUs)
denominator_hw_meaning: TCP_TOTAL_CACHE_ACCESSES_sum: total cache lookups in vL1D (sum over CUs)
correct_aggregate_definition: Overall vL1D hit rate. Weighted by access count.

numerator_hw_meaning: TCP_GATE_EN2_sum: cycles TCP core clocks on (sum over CUs, not windowable)
denominator_hw_meaning: TCP_GATE_EN1_sum: cycles TCP interface clocks on (sum over CUs, free-running, not windowable)
correct_aggregate_definition: What fraction of vL1D active cycles had processing? Weighted by active cycles.

numerator_hw_meaning: TCP_PENDING_STALL_CYCLES_sum: cycles vL1D stalled waiting for L2 data (sum over CUs)
denominator_hw_meaning: TCP_GATE_EN1_sum: vL1D active cycles (free-running, sum over CUs)
correct_aggregate_definition: Per-dispatch stall rate (simple_box: shows distribution).

numerator_hw_meaning: vL1D cache hits
correct_aggregate_definition: Overall hit rate. Weighted by access count.

current_formula: AVG((100 * TCP_UTCL1_TRANSLATION_HIT_sum / TCP_UTCL1_REQUEST_sum) if != 0 else None)
numerator_hw_meaning: TCP_UTCL1_TRANSLATION_HIT_sum: UTCL1 translation hits (sum over CUs)
denominator_hw_meaning: TCP_UTCL1_REQUEST_sum: total UTCL1 translation requests (sum over CUs)
correct_aggregate_definition: Overall UTCL1 hit rate. Weighted by request count.

numerator_hw_meaning: SQ_LDS_IDX_ACTIVE: cycles LDS is busy processing (per-simd)
correct_aggregate_definition: What fraction of CU-cycles had LDS active? Weighted by active cycles.

numerator_hw_meaning: SQ_LDS_BANK_CONFLICT: cycles LDS stalled due to bank conflicts (per-simd) * 3.125 normalization
denominator_hw_meaning: SQ_LDS_IDX_ACTIVE - SQ_LDS_BANK_CONFLICT: uncontended LDS access cycles
correct_aggregate_definition: Conflict rate relative to uncontended accesses. Weighted by access volume.

numerator_hw_meaning: SQ_ACCUM_PREV_HIRES: level counter accumulating SQ_INST_LEVEL_LDS (in-flight LDS instructions per cycle)
denominator_hw_meaning: SQ_INSTS_LDS: total LDS instructions issued (per-simd, emulated)
correct_aggregate_definition: Average cycles per LDS instruction. Weighted by instruction count.

numerator_hw_meaning: SQ_LDS_BANK_CONFLICT: conflict cycles
correct_aggregate_definition: Overall ratio. Weighted by access volume.

numerator_hw_meaning: SQ_INSTS: instructions issued (per-simd, emulated)
correct_aggregate_definition: Overall IPC. Weighted by busy cycles.

numerator_hw_meaning: Total non-internal instructions issued
denominator_hw_meaning: SQ_ACTIVE_INST_ANY: quad-cycles any wave working on any instruction (per-simd, emulated)
correct_aggregate_definition: Issued IPC. Weighted by active cycles.

numerator_hw_meaning: SQ_ACTIVE_INST_SCA: SALU/SMEM busy quad-cycles
correct_aggregate_definition: SALU busy fraction. Weighted by active cycles.

numerator_hw_meaning: SQ_THREAD_CYCLES_VALU: quad-cycles * active thread count (per-simd)
correct_aggregate_definition: Average active threads per VALU instruction. Weighted by instruction count.

numerator_hw_meaning: SQ_VALU_MFMA_BUSY_CYCLES: cycles MFMA unit busy
correct_aggregate_definition: Average cycles per MFMA instruction. Weighted by instruction count.

numerator_hw_meaning: SQ_ACCUM_PREV_HIRES: level counter for SQ_INST_LEVEL_VMEM (in-flight VMEM instructions)
denominator_hw_meaning: SQ_INSTS_VMEM: total VMEM instructions issued (per-simd, emulated)
correct_aggregate_definition: Average round-trip cycles per VMEM instruction. Weighted by instruction count.

numerator_hw_meaning: SQ_ACCUM_PREV_HIRES: level counter for SQ_INST_LEVEL_SMEM (in-flight SMEM instructions)
denominator_hw_meaning: SQ_INSTS_SMEM: total SMEM instructions issued (per-simd, emulated)
correct_aggregate_definition: Average round-trip cycles per SMEM instruction. Weighted by instruction count.

numerator_hw_meaning: SQ_ACTIVE_INST_VALU2: quad-cycles two VALU instructions co-issued (per-simd, nondeterministic)
denominator_hw_meaning: SQ_ACTIVE_INST_VALU - SQ_ACTIVE_INST_VALU2: quad-cycles single VALU issued
correct_aggregate_definition: Ratio of dual-issue to single-issue VALU cycles. Weighted by cycle count.

current_formula: AVG((100 * CPC_CPC_STAT_BUSY / CPC_CPC_STAT_IDLE) if != 0 else None)
numerator_hw_meaning: CPC_CPC_STAT_BUSY: CPC busy cycles
correct_aggregate_definition: CPC busy fraction. Weighted by total cycles.

numerator_hw_meaning: SPI_RA_REQ_NO_ALLOC_LEVEL: accumulated in-flight allocation requests
correct_aggregate_definition: Average cycles per wave allocation. Weighted by request count.

numerator_hw_meaning: SQ_INSTS: instructions issued (per-simd, emulated)
denominator_hw_meaning: SQ_WAVES: waves sent to SQ (per-simd, emulated, global)
correct_aggregate_definition: Overall instructions per wavefront. Weighted by wavefront count.

numerator_hw_meaning: SQ_ACCUM_PREV_HIRES: level counter for resident wavefronts
correct_aggregate_definition: Time-averaged resident wavefronts. Weighted by active cycles.

numerator_hw_meaning: SQC_ICACHE_HITS: L1I hits
denominator_hw_meaning: Total L1I requests (hits + misses + duplicate misses)
correct_aggregate_definition: Overall L1I hit rate. Weighted by request count.

numerator_hw_meaning: SQ_ACCUM_PREV_HIRES: level counter for SQC_ICACHE_INFLIGHT_LEVEL
correct_aggregate_definition: Average cycles per fetch. Weighted by fetch count.

current_formula: AVG((SQC_DCACHE_HITS * 100 / (HITS + MISSES + MISSES_DUP)) if != 0 else None)
numerator_hw_meaning: SQC_DCACHE_HITS: sL1D hits
correct_aggregate_definition: Overall sL1D hit rate. Weighted by request count.

numerator_hw_meaning: TA_TA_BUSY_sum: address processor busy cycles (sum over CUs)
correct_aggregate_definition: TA busy fraction. Weighted by active cycles.

numerator_hw_meaning: TD_TD_BUSY_sum: data-return unit busy cycles (sum over CUs)
correct_aggregate_definition: TD busy fraction. Weighted by active cycles.

numerator_hw_meaning: SUM(TCC_HIT[i]): total L2 hits across all channels (per-channel counter, summed inline)
denominator_hw_meaning: SUM(TCC_HIT[i]+TCC_MISS[i]): total L2 lookups across all channels
correct_aggregate_definition: Overall L2 hit rate across channels. Weighted by request count.

numerator_hw_meaning: TCC_HIT[ch]: per-channel L2 hits
correct_aggregate_definition: Per-channel hit rate (simple_box: shows distribution across dispatches).

numerator_hw_meaning: TCC_EA0_RDREQ_LEVEL[ch]: per-channel accumulated in-flight EA reads
denominator_hw_meaning: TCC_EA0_RDREQ[ch]: per-channel total EA read requests
correct_aggregate_definition: Per-channel per-dispatch read latency (simple_box: shows distribution).

numerator_hw_meaning: SQ_WAVE_CYCLES: cycles wave is resident on CU * 4 (quad-cycle conversion)
denominator_hw_meaning: SQ_WAVES: total waves sent to SQ
correct_aggregate_definition: Average cycles per wavefront. Weighted by wavefront count.

numerator_hw_meaning: vL1D cache hits (total - misses)
correct_aggregate_definition: Overall vL1D hit rate. Weighted by access count.

numerator_hw_meaning: TCP_TCP_LATENCY_sum: accumulated vL1D request latency (sum over CUs)
denominator_hw_meaning: TCP_TA_TCP_STATE_READ_sum: read state requests (sum over CUs)
correct_aggregate_definition: Average vL1D access latency. Weighted by request count.

numerator_hw_meaning: TCC_EA0_RDREQ_LEVEL_sum: accumulated in-flight EA reads
correct_aggregate_definition: Average fabric read latency. Weighted by request count.
